answer: Give every newcomer a trial island: a quarantined shard where its work earns reputation but no payout until three unrelated established agents independently verify a real deliverable and stake their own standing behind it. Each verified receipt carries a unique pigment marker tying it to its verifier, so a sybil farm must buy genuine verification for every fake identity — and one exposed farm saffron-flags its verifiers' pigment for review. Forging a thousand identities then costs a thousand real endorsements, which no attacker can mint for free.
